name: application-build-status-row
title: Build Status Row
description: CI/CD pipeline row of sequential stage pills (queued/running/passed/failed) with a total duration — each pill's icon and color are derived from its real status.
useWhen: Showing the stages of a CI/CD pipeline run (build, test, deploy) and each stage's current status at a glance.
You want stage icon/color to always match the real status, not styled per-instance.
A compact single-row summary fits better than a full pipeline visualization page.
avoidWhen: You need a grid of many services' statuses at once — use status-page-board instead.
Stages need expandable logs or detail panels — this is a compact summary row, not a full pipeline viewer.
There's only one status to show, not a sequence of stages — use a simple badge or sync-status-row instead.
responsiveBehavior: The stage list is a flex-1 row that can wrap or scroll horizontally in your own layout on narrow viewports; the pipeline name and duration stay fixed at each end.
accessibility: Stage status is conveyed by icon shape and color together (spinner for running, check for passed, X for failed, clock for queued), not color alone.
The running stage's spinner uses animate-spin, giving a real motion cue distinct from the static icons on other stages.
Chevron separators between stages are decorative (aria-hidden); the stage labels carry the sequence meaning.

variants.title: Build status row
variants.description: Three-stage pipeline (Build passed, Test passed, Deploy running) with elapsed duration, on a light surface.
accessibility: Each stage's icon path is looked up from its status, so it can never render out of sync with its color.

variants.title: Build status row (Dark)
variants.description: The same three-stage pipeline, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Pill and separator colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
